# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the Control Sanitizers workflow (fork only).
#
# Upstream behaviour, not changed by this fork: OpenTune::ProcessRenderRuntime
# (Source/Runtime/ProcessRenderRuntime.cpp) starts its control worker thread
# (controlWorker_) in the constructor and again in retainOwner(), and does not
# join it before process exit. TSan reports that as a thread leak at exit.
#
# Only thread leaks whose creation stack goes through those two functions are
# suppressed. Data races, deadlocks and every other thread leak stay fatal.
thread:*ProcessRenderRuntime::ProcessRenderRuntime*
thread:*ProcessRenderRuntime::retainOwner*
